_readme: Krafting with Kay: events data. Edit this file to update workshops everywhere: the homepage 'Upcoming sessions' list and the full calendar page (events.html) both render from here automatically. RECURRING: weekly template (weekday 0=Sun..6=Sat; 3=Wednesday). WEEKS_OUT: how many weeks of sessions to generate. EVENTS: one-off specials; each needs title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and optionally startTime/endTime/location/price/description/tag. Leave EVENTS empty if none.

recurring.title: Open Krafting
recurring.price: $25 per person · $5 off when you bring a friend
recurring.description: Weekly open crafting night. Each month has a theme. This season it's all about birds: birdhouses, feeders, and feathered friends.
